t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Keep an eye out for the gnomes that end up together and try to figure out which one gives the most point. Try on the 1x rather than the 5x. Keep an eye on the colors if too fast.

vb_textbox.text:
Keep
 these rules in mind - There are 4x pairs of gnomes that always appear 
together in a round- Using that information see which gnome in the pair 
gives you the most mushrooms.- If the mushroom quantity lowers straight 
away start going for other gnome.- The pairs reset when the round is 
overTips - Remember the colours rather than the gnome pairs if it's too 
fast - The time it takes for the basket to appear is constant so you can
 predict when to hit space- It's better to test and be wrong on 1x 
rather 5x multipliers
